title: lathyrus maritimus var. pellitus
intro: Lathyrus maritimus var. pellitus, commonly known as sea peavine or salt-marsh pea, is a plant species within the Fabaceae family. It is traditionally used for its medicinal properties, which include providing health benefits such as reducing inflammation and improving cardiovascular health. The therapeutic actions of Lathyrus maritimus var. pellitus are attributed to its ability to act as an antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and vasodilator, which can help in lowering blood pressure and improving blood circulation. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
